text: SA CoParents Align — professional & court tools for child-focused family resolution.
1 · A judge signs in to the Judicial Portal. First-timers get a guided welcome and a 1-minute tour.
2 · The Judicial Portal: refer cases, track status, read frozen packets. Raw parent answers are never shown.
3 · Refer a case: cause number, parties, hearing date and a nearby verified professional.
4 · The professional's dashboard: Invite Parents → Review Joint Report → Create Professional Report.
5 · Each parent receives a private invitation. Parents never see each other's answers.
6 · The workflow pipeline tracks every case from individual assessments to the final report.
7 · When both parents finish, the Joint Report compares perspectives — neutral and system-generated.
8 · Areas of alignment, differences in perspective, and child-focused needs — side by side.
9 · The Professional Alignment Report editor: cover page, then 11 numbered sections.
10 · The finished PDF — Page 1 professional contact cover and the 'How to Read This Report' guide.
11 · Child-Focused Legal Issues, Options & Resources, pathways — and the signed Professional Certification.
12 · The Align Assistant drafts neutral text for review — advisory only, never a custody recommendation.
13 · The professional certifies and finalizes. PDF, ZIP bundle or court packet — one click.
14 · The judge receives the hash-sealed court packet with a reader guide beside each report.
